description: Bicep template declaring a module alongside a resource
note: A template that declares a module as well as a resource -- the shape remediation-agent's Bicep structural guard has to read, since deleting a module drops a whole sub-template. Bicep now has two sources, not one. KICS parses .bicep natively where Trivy has no Bicep scanner at all, so this case's self-check compares two tools and the single-source caveat multi-iac-spec §4 carried for Bicep is retired.
